note: Development briefs for checking and tuning interpretation. Authored for Countertrace by the coding assistant; not independently authored. Labels are the author's reading of the contract profile.

briefs.text: A 4-entry, 8-bit FIFO for a UART receive path. Bytes must come out in the order they arrived. When the FIFO is full, new bytes are dropped rather than overwriting stored ones. Reset clears the FIFO.
A 4-entry, 8-bit synchronous FIFO with synchronous active-high reset. Writes when full and reads when empty are ignored.
A 4-entry FIFO. If it is full and a read and write arrive together, it should still accept the write because the read frees a slot.
Two-entry byte FIFO between two blocks on the same clock. The reset is asynchronous so the FIFO clears immediately when rst rises, without waiting for a clock edge.
A 4-deep FIFO of bytes in first-word fall-through mode: the oldest byte is already visible on dout whenever the FIFO is not empty, and rd_en just acknowledges it.
A 4-entry streaming FIFO where reads and writes often happen in the same cycle. Order must be preserved, including when both happen together while partially full.
